_readme: The launcher's front page. Commit a change here and players see it on
their next launch -- no release, no rebuild, no token.
Read from:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reBalance-Of-Souls/reBalanceOfSouls.github.io/main/news.json
Each item needs a title. image, link and kind are optional:
title  the caption on the bar at the bottom. Keep it to one line.
image  the artwork. See below.
link   opened in the player's browser when they click the caption bar.
kind   news | changelog | shoutout. Free text; anything unknown is
still shown rather than dropped.
ARTWORK
Put the file in this repository and name it relative to this file:
"image": "news/zangetsu.png"
which is resolved against wherever news.json was loaded from, the way
a browser resolves it. A full https:// URL still works and is left
alone, so art hosted elsewhere is fine too.
Size: 1280x720 or anything near 16:9 fills the window. Something much
squarer, or smaller than about 900px wide, is shown whole and centred
over a blurred copy of itself rather than being magnified -- so a
small image looks deliberate instead of soft.
PNG or JPEG. Windows reads both; the Linux build will only read PNG,
so PNG is the safer choice for anything that has to work on both.
An item with no image is not broken -- it shows the launcher's own
background. It is just quieter than the ones with art.
Items appear in the order written -- first is shown first.
Keys starting with _ are ignored by the launcher, including this one.
If this file is ever broken, the launcher refuses it by name and falls
back to the last copy that parsed, so a bad edit will not blank the
front page. A single malformed item is skipped and the rest still show.
Bump schema only if the launcher's own format changes -- not for content.
The YouTube images below are each video's own thumbnail. maxresdefault
is the 1280x720 one; if a video has no maxres upload that URL 404s and
the item simply shows with no art. Swap in your own whenever you have it.
